items.label: Size & Washing
items.value: XS=US(0-2), S=US(4-6), M=US(8-10), L=US(12-14), XL=(16-18), 2XL=(20-22). Machine wash cold with like colors in laundry bag, lay flat to dry. Dry clean recommended. Do not bleach, iron, or tumble dry.

items: Material：Made from high-quality materials, this sweater is soft, durable, and easy to care for. It maintains its shape and color even after multiple washes and is breathable for all-day comfort.

items.label: Designs
items.value: Featuring a flattering crew-neck and delicate batwing long sleeves, this tunic top offer a modern and versatile look.

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Ideal for vacation, casual daily wear, office, shopping, travel, work, and more. Suitable for both fall and winter, as well as spring.

items.label: Matching
items.value: Layer under cardigans in cooler months or wear solo in warmer seasons. Pair it with jeans or leggings for a casual and relaxed look, or dress it up with a skirt and accessories for a more polished ensemble.
